newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end down, seen vulnerable.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end down, seen vulnerable.

text.p: 1510 GMT - Austrian shares slipped 1.15 percent on Monday, knocked lower by a weak international environment. Traders said weak tone may remain on Tuesday and forecast a volatile few days ahead of the expiry of March ATX futures on Friday.
* Leading ATX decliner chip maker AMS, down 4.71 percent at 1,110.10 ats.
* Top ATX gainer hosiery maker Wolford, up 1.07 percent at 1,420 ats.
* March ATX future down 20.3 points at 1,220.1. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
